name: Novo Nordisk A/S (B)
businessSummary: Danish pharmaceutical group focused on diabetes and obesity care (semaglutide: Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus, Wegovy pill) plus rare disease. Reports adjusted figures in 2026 that exclude a one-off US 340B provision reversal.

high52w.note: unavailable. Context: share fell ~17-18% on 4 Feb 2026 on guidance for a 2026 sales decline.

marketCap.note: Derived: 272.70 x 4,420m = ~DKK 1,205bn (stockanalysis DKK 1.15T on 2026-10-23 at DKK 260.15).

Stockanalysis EV 1.25T minus market cap 1.15T (2026-10-23) implies net debt ~DKK 100bn, and agent ND/EBITDA is +0.49, so treated as net debt (not net cash). Includes leases? Not verified. Q3 2026 net debt not retrieved.

guidance2026.basis: Adjusted sales growth and adjusted operating profit growth, constant exchange rates (CER); adjusted excludes the US 340B provision reversal
guidance2026.original_2026-02-04: -5% to -13% for both (shares fell ~17-18% on the day)
guidance2026.2026-08-04: 0% to -6% for both (raised, on higher GLP-1 expectations)
guidance2026.2026-11-04: -2% to +2% for both (raised again; third raise in 2026 per press; Q3 report)
guidance2026.reportedNote: Excluding adjustments the Aug midpoints implied +5% sales and +12% operating profit growth; the Nov reported-basis range not retrieved.
guidance2026.note: Even the raised range implies adjusted sales and operating profit roughly flat in 2026 after +10% sales in 2025; the raises are from a deeply cut base.

q3_2026.impairmentDetail: DKK 4.6bn ziltivekimab, DKK 4.1bn manufacturing network right-sizing (non-cash)

sectorMetrics.pricingPressure: US realised prices lower under the Most Favoured Nation agreement; IRA maximum fair price for Wegovy/Ozempic/Rybelsus effective 2027 (company said it would have been a negative low-single-digit impact on global sales growth if applied in 2025); reduced Medicaid obesity coverage; semaglutide patent expiry in key international markets; compounded semaglutide. Cited as reasons for the Feb 2026 guide. Q3 2026 US injectable Wegovy -13% CER.
sectorMetrics.competition: Lilly: Foundayo (oral GLP-1) 'winning a growing share of new prescriptions'; Lilly raised its own outlook the week before Novo's Q3. Novo estimates ~80% of US new-to-brand pill prescriptions for the Wegovy pill (company claim, via Finimize). Zepbound/Mounjaro outsold Wegovy/Ozempic (Q3 2025).
sectorMetrics.estimateRevisions: Guidance raised three times since Feb (May, Aug, Nov), Q3 adjusted sales and operating profit beat consensus (79.2bn vs 73.2bn; 31.7bn vs 28.4bn). Post-Q3 consensus EPS revisions not retrieved. Agent consensus: 24 analysts, hold; mean target DKK 299.9 vs price 272.7 (low 221, high 448).
sectorMetrics.rdPipeline: Impairments in 2026: monlunabant (DKK 4.0bn, Q2), ziltivekimab (DKK 4.6bn, Q3).

recentEvents: 4 Nov 2026 Q3: adjusted sales DKK 79.2bn (consensus 73.2bn), adjusted operating profit DKK 31.7bn (+27% CER; consensus 28.4bn); reported operating profit DKK 23.0bn (-9% CER) after DKK 8.7bn impairments; 2026 outlook raised to -2% to +2% adjusted (third raise).
Wegovy pill Q3 sales DKK 5.39bn (+53% QoQ, vs consensus 4.62bn); ~3.6m US prescriptions in Q3; sold in 8 markets.
US injectable Wegovy sales -13% CER in Q3; combined US Wegovy +21% (pill included).
4 Aug 2026: outlook raised to 0% to -6%; 6 May 2026 raised to -4% to -12%; 4 Feb 2026 original -5% to -13% (shares -17/-18%).
Q3 2025 context: guidance cut, CEO change (Mike Doustdar), layoffs, shareholder board dispute.
9M 2026 adjusted sales +2% CER; adjusted operating profit +8% CER.
valueTrapFlags: Low trailing P/E (10.7x) is flattered by the one-off 340B reversal; adjusted sales are flat to slightly down for 2026 even after three guidance raises.
Adjusted sales guidance -2% to +2% follows +10% in 2025; FY2025 operating profit fell 0.5% and EPS barely grew (22.63 to 23.03).
US pricing reset (MFN, 2027 IRA price), patent expiries and compounders structurally compress price/margin; US injectable Wegovy -13% in Q3.
Competition from Lilly Foundayo/tirzepatide gaining new prescriptions; the Wegovy pill (~6% of expected sales) must carry the recovery.

Q3 adjusted operating profit +27% benefited from an easy comparison base and a stronger beat than the guidance range implies; reported Q3 operating profit -9% CER; recurring impairments (DKK 6.3bn Q2, 8.7bn Q3).
Free cash flow weaker than earnings under company definition (FY2025 DKK 28.3bn vs operating profit 127.7bn, after Catalent); net debt ~DKK 95bn at FY2025 after prior net cash.
Positive: estimates/guidance moving up since February, consensus sits above price (mean 299.9), ROIC high; but consensus is hold (5 buy, 15 hold, 6 sell).

valuation.method: Next-12m adjusted EPS x justified P/E. Basis DKK 21.0 = provider forward EPS about 21.3 (derived), trimmed for US price resets in 2027. Trailing P/E 10.7 flattered by a one-off 340B reversal, not used.

bear.note: Lilly takes share, US IRA/MFN pricing cuts margins. Justified multiple 10x on next-12m 19.74.

base.note: Volume growth offsets price cuts; oral Wegovy holds share. Justified multiple 14x on next-12m 21.63.

bull.note: Obesity market expansion, pill success, new indications. Justified multiple 18x on next-12m 22.68.

valuation.whyItFits: Diabetes/obesity leader with ROIC about 39%, low leverage (ND/EBITDA 0.5x), 4.3% yield; guidance raised three times in 2026 and Q3 adjusted profit beat by 12%.
valuation.growthDrivers: Wegovy pill, global obesity volume growth, CagriSema pipeline, international markets.
valuation.saturation: Deeply de-rated: P/E about 12-13 on adjusted earnings versus 30x+ in 2023; pessimism priced, but the earnings base is resetting.
valuation.principalRisk: US price resets (MFN, IRA 2027) and Lilly's share gains shrink the earnings base faster than volumes grow.
